items_flat.title_en: FT: residual-value guarantees hide up to $300B of AI infrastructure exposure
items_flat.title_zh: FT：殘值擔保使高達3,000億美元AI基建曝險留在資產負債表外
items_flat.summary_en: The Financial Times reported that technology firms have offered as much as $300 billion of residual-value guarantees over the past year to back AI data-center and chip financing through special-purpose vehicles. Follow-on coverage named Meta’s Hyperion / Beignet structure (~$28B guarantee behind ~$27B of project debt), Broadcom exposure tied to Anthropic-bound chips, Nvidia guarantees linked to a SoftBank–OpenAI development, and Alphabet data-center guarantees rising from $16.9B to $43.8B in six months with little booked as on-balance-sheet liability.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《金融時報》報導，科技公司過去一年透過特殊目的公司，為AI資料中心與晶片融資提供高達約3,000億美元殘值擔保。後續整理點名Meta路易斯安那Hyperion／Beignet結構（約280億美元擔保支撐約270億美元專案債）、Broadcom與Anthropic晶片融資相關曝險、輝達與軟銀—OpenAI開發案相關擔保，以及Alphabet資料中心擔保半年內由169億升至438億美元、入帳負債極少。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is not a model launch, but it is how frontier capacity is being paid for: demand and residual-value risk are shifted into contingent guarantees that appear late, if at all, as ordinary debt. What remains uncertain is whether GPU and campus residuals hold if utilization or rental prices normalize—the structures work only while the assets stay financeable.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這不是模型發表，而是前線算力如何被付錢：需求與殘值風險被移到或然擔保，未必即時進入一般負債。不確定點在於，若利用率或租賃價格回歸常態，GPU與園區殘值能否撐住——結構成立的前提是資產仍可融資。

items_flat.title_en: Nvidia posts Jensen Huang CBS Sunday remarks: speed and safeguards ‘aren’t at odds’
items_flat.title_zh: 輝達轉發黃仁勳CBS訪談：速度與防護「並不對立」
items_flat.summary_en: Nvidia’s official account posted a CBS Sunday clip of CEO Jensen Huang arguing that moving fast on AI and building safely are compatible if testing, monitoring, and safeguards run in parallel. CBS News separately quoted him rejecting 2030 extinction timelines as a “doomsday narrative,” saying there is a “0% chance” 2030 is “the end of the world,” while also saying the U.S. should not slow the AI race with China and should not ship products before they are ready. The company linked an extended interview on CBS.
items_flat.summary_zh: 輝達官方帳號轉發CBS Sunday片段，執行長黃仁勳主張只要測試、監控與防護同步進行，AI快速推進與安全並不衝突。CBS另引述他否定2030滅絕時間表為「末日敘事」，稱2030是世界末日的機率為「0%」，同時表示美國不應在對中AI競賽中放慢、也不該在產品未就緒時出貨。公司並附上延伸訪談連結。
items_flat.analysis_en: The clip is messaging, not a product or capital-commitment change. It lands in the same window as reporting on large Nvidia-linked infrastructure guarantees, so the public line on speed-plus-safety is running beside contingent financing that assumes residuals hold.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是對外表述，不是產品或資本承諾的變更。它與輝達相關大型基建擔保報導落在同一時窗，公開的「速度加安全」論述，與假設殘值仍站得住的或然融資並排出現。
items_flat.quote: Moving fast and building safely aren’t at odds. AI should move as fast as we can, with rigorous testing, monitoring, and safeguards every step of the way.
items_flat.quote_zh: 快速推進與安全打造並不對立。AI應盡可能快，但每一步都要有嚴謹測試、監控與防護。
